title: Drainage Myth vs Fact: Chemical Cleaners
description: A common assumption when facing a slow drain is reaching for a harsh chemical liquid cleaner. However, professional plumbers know these products can cause more harm than good, especially in older or metallic piping systems. Corrosive chemicals can generate extreme heat, warping plastic pipes or deteriorating degraded metal walls. More importantly, when they fail to clear a stubborn clog, they leave standing hazardous liquid in the pipe, creating a dangerous safety hazard for anyone servicing the line. Learning proper mechanical clearing methods protects both your plumbing infrastructure and your personal safety on the job.
